title: See whether your client opened the estimate

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: After you send an estimate, the CRM shows you whether your client has opened it.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: On Clients, search for the client.

steps.caption: The estimate you sent
steps.narration: Under Estimates, here is the estimate that was sent.

steps.caption: Not opened yet
steps.narration: Under the buttons, it shows when it was sent. And for now: Not opened yet.

steps.caption: The client opens it
steps.narration: Now say your client opens the estimate from their email, and comes back to it twice.

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: Open Estimates in the left menu.

steps.caption: Viewed
steps.narration: The estimate's status now reads viewed, not sent.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: Click its number to open it.

steps.caption: Opened
steps.narration: The line at the top says when it was first opened, and how many views it has had.

steps.caption: The client's page
steps.narration: For the detail, click the client's name.

steps.caption: Visits and time
steps.narration: Under the estimate: the visits, the total time spent, and how long ago the last one was.

steps.caption: Each visit
steps.narration: Each visit is listed: its time, how long it lasted, and the network address.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: You will find this on every client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: How to see if a client opened your estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: ConstructHUB CRM shows when a sent estimate was first opened, how many times your client came back to it and how long they spent. This walkthrough shows where those lines are on the client's page and on Estimates. Recorded in a demo workspace; the client's visits are simulated.
